chunk_map.heading: Being wrong does not diminish you

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "The blur did not go away." and L6 "with it" and L12 "the digest" are the closest to unresolved; each resolves: 'the blur' continues the immediately preceding slide in the lecture's include order (all-was-blurry, 'About the future, all was blurry'), and 'the digest' is named in the earlier slides analysed-everything-no-insight L4 and a-faster-feature-factory L6. Immediate-continuation and module-arc carve-outs apply.
L4: "The blur did not go away." is the only backward gesture; it names the thing (the blur), not a file by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "The blur" points at a beat that exists: slides/all-was-blurry.md is included on lecture L11 directly before this slide (lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md L11-13).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "Being wrong does not diminish you. Lack of effort to understand does." is a self-carrying claim; the chunk is six short paragraphs of connected argument, not a wait-state.
L1 header "Being wrong does not diminish you" vs L8 "Being wrong does not diminish you. Lack of effort to understand does.": the chunk argues exactly this; nothing contradicts the header.

L8: "Being wrong does not diminish you. Lack of effort to understand does." is the closest, a two-part contrast not a Not-X-Not-Y-Z; no anaphora triple, no self-grading superlative, no number+retraction, no verb triplet, no abstraction-noun stack (L4 'neural pathways' is a concrete metaphor in the maintainer's own words, backing 'see-the-patterns').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L12: "the digest" is the training's ordinary object name in the room, not repo vocabulary; grep of body view dialect terms (surface-as-noun, compendium, beat, mood, forcing function) = none. L4 'neural pathways' is plain speech.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-13 -> 0: no bold on the slide, budget of <=1 unspent.

rules_evaluated.evidence: lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md L13 includes the slide as a standalone include line, so it is inlined into the composed deck; slide-file mechanism, not a phase-less prose section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "Being wrong does not diminish you. Lack of effort to understand does." half-restates the L1 header, the nearest to class (c) aphorism kicker; it stays inside because the sentence carries a second half the header lacks ('Lack of effort to understand does') and is maintainer-attested essay wording (backing claim lack-of-effort, guard: cut rather than reword). L12 adds the Day 2 application, new content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: no retitle signature: L2 slide id equals the file name, maintainer note carries no '(from <old-file>, header his)' provenance, and every paragraph answers the current header.
